Name: Spouse Warp
Author: Kreestijan
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Spouse Warp[/b][/size][/center]

[b]Description[/b]
[line]
Spouse Warp adds a warp panel to the right side of the vanilla inventory menu. Each target appears as a row with a portrait and a decoration slot, but it is primarily a mod to teleport to your spouse so that's its behavior by default.
Clicking a valid portrait warps you to that target for a configurable gold cost. 
Ctrl + Right Click on the decoration slot cycles that target’s badge. You can add 32x32 png files to the decoration folder for more.
It needs more testing, if you encounter an issue please report it so I can fix it. Thank you!


[b]Main Features[/b]
[line]
[list]
[*]Warp to your spouse instantly from the vanilla inventory menu[/*]
[*]Warp sets you to the closest safe tile, so you don't get stuck[/*]
[*]Customizable gold cost per warp[/*]
[*]Configurable cooldown per warp[/*]
[*]Customizable list of NPCs to warp to[/*]
[*]SOS button to warp you home at no cost[/*]
[*]Decoration slot with different icons for each Spouse/Player/NPC[/*]
[*]Configurable widget offsets and scale[/*]
[*]Automatically loading all available NPCs (modded too) + toggle for each[/*]
[*]Safeguard to stop warping if the target is in cutscenes/festivals/locked areas (the latter is not foolproof)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[line]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] -> required[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] -> optional but recommended[/*]
[/list]

[b]Installation[/b]
[line]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game once to generate the config.[/*]
[*]Adjust settings via config.json or Generic Mod Config Menu in-game.[/*]
[/list]

[b]Compatibility[/b]
[line]
✅ Built for Stardew Valley 1.6+
✅ Multiplayer compatible
✅ SDV
✅ RSV
✅ ES
❌ N/A
